name: Reinforced gambeson
description: A gambeson with leather panels stitched over the ribs. A tailor’s answer to an armourer’s question.
notes: Fine light body armor. Weight 2.5 kg (ADR-0003 reference weights). Catalogue tier fine (economy doc, body armor light 90-140 x2.5). Authored for shop stock (mw-ju8.3); not for sale until a shop row stocks it (mw-ju8.5).
